E0504

Mixed-type list/map literal

What

Mixed-type list/map literal

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0504

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0504: tests/ui/mixed_list.stderr.

Error [E0504]: this list resolves to `Int` but item 2 is `String`
  --> tests/ui/mixed_list.jet:2:15
    |
  2 |     xs :: [1, "two"]
    |               ^^^^^
 Why: every item in a list literal must have the same type
 Fix: make every element the same type, or build the list in steps
